threshold_objective: Shared full/crop threshold minimizing mean balanced abstention error: 0.5*(FA/3 + FR/10), averaged over the two views. Ties: greater mean coverage, then lower threshold. Development-tuned on these same labels.
primary_abstention: None; return all eligible candidates in ranked order. Hit/Recall use top 3, nDCG uses top 5.
secondary_abstention: Accept the whole ranking iff its maximum cosine similarity >= shared threshold; otherwise return an empty list.
category_baseline: Uniform category-only order using Random(str(seed)+':'+query_id) on sorted compound item IDs. No threshold or appearance features. Also calculate exact expected uniform-order Hit@3 analytically.
assisted_rule_baseline: Only if independently human-annotated observable attributes exist; no attributes inferred from filenames or relevance grades. Otherwise skip with reason.
encoder: One verified lightweight ImageNet image encoder, classifier removed; L2-normalized embeddings, cosine similarity. Exact checkpoint/revision/weight hash recorded before adoption in configs/001c-encoder.json.
ranking_inputs: Decoded RGB pixels and category/active-wardrobe membership only. No source filenames, relevance grades, no-match flags or reviewer notes as feature inputs. Stable compound item ID tie-break only.
resources: Fresh child process on the confirmed Windows laptop; CPU float32, batch 1, 2 intra-op/1 inter-op threads, eval/inference mode. Measure perf_counter_ns wall time for imports/model load, first image transform+encode (process-cold; OS cache uncontrolled), wardrobe cache creation, remaining unique image embeddings and three warm transform+encode+score repetitions per task/view with wardrobe embeddings reused. Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo PeakWorkingSetSize for lifetime process peak RSS. GPU unused; VRAM null with reason. Report phase timings separately, disk bytes, failures and missing values. No invented performance budget.
metrics: Existing evaluator, raw and validated: per-task and aggregates Hit@3, Recall@3, graded nDCG@5, coverage, invalid/cross-wardrobe IDs, category errors, duplicates, FA out of 3 no-match tasks, FR out of 10 matchable tasks. No-match retrieval metrics null; matchable denominator 10.
occlusion: Keep both confirmed blue-jorts components with their existing notes. No score-based exclusions.
privacy: Real inputs, input hashes, labels, weights, embeddings, per-task rankings/scores, resource traces and reports only in ignored local directories. Commit generic code/configuration, synthetic tests and methodology only.
limits: One person/wardrobe/reviewer, six inspirations, correlated components; three no-match tasks. Tiny candidate pools; flag N<=3. Descriptive development findings only, no held-out or population claims. Human effort remains unknown. Final evaluation contract remains draft/open. Stop after 001C.
